'''2001 New York State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship played on 19 May 2001 at the Altered States store in New York.<ref name="tr-d2349">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-21-new-york-state-championships-5-19-01d2349/ new-york-state-championships-5-19-01], DeckTech (Josh "Jizosh003" Paterniti, 21 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-21-new-york-state-championships-5-19-01d2349/ GitHub Pages].</ref> [[Brian Terwilliger]] and a player named Pete played the final; the report that records the event does not say who won.

* '''Date:''' 19 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Altered States, New York
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' unknown
